mission.title: Mission & vision
mission.body:
I am an HCI researcher and technology-based artist interested in multimodal HCI and human–food interaction.

I am currently interested in exploring how emerging technologies might help people better interact with and play with food and flavor. The complicated differences between modalities are never only a matter of sensory perception; they are also connected to cultural context and the effects of digital systems.

My own goal is to build systems, prototypes, and artworks that bring together computer systems, machinery, AI, and chemical components. I want to create experiences across different modalities that make people think more about the possibilities of interaction among different senses, art, and technology.

about.title: About me
about.body: I am Po-Yu Chen (pillow), a master's student at NTU's Graduate Institute of Networking and Multimedia. I am currently working under the advisement of Professor Lung-Pan Cheng, and I am seeking opportunities and information related to research, art, and startups.

mission.title: 使命與願景
mission.body:
我是一名 HCI 研究者與科技藝術工作者，對多模態 HCI 與食物設計感興趣。

我目前正在探索新興科技如何幫助人們更好地與食物和風味互動、玩耍。不同模態之間複雜的差異，從來不只是感官知覺的問題；它們也與文化脈絡以及數位系統所帶來的影響有關。

我自己的目標，是建立能夠將電腦系統、機械、AI 與化學元件整合在一起的系統、原型與藝術作品。我希望創造跨越不同模態的體驗，讓人們更多思考不同感官、藝術與科技之間互動的可能性。

about.title: 關於我
about.body: 我叫陳柏諭（pillow），是台大網路與多媒體研究所的碩士生。我目前在 Lung-Pan Cheng 教授的指導下，尋找研究、藝術與新創相關的機會與資訊。
